name: paper
description: Cross-scenario sweep behind every table and figure in evaluations/reports/. Checkpoints: evaluations/pool/cross_scenario/; intermediates: this directory.
planner: CEM as configured in configs/<scenario>/planner.yaml; no prior-margin guard in any scenario.
selection: selection.json, written by python -m evaluations.paper.cross_scenario.selection from evaluations/pool/cross_scenario/candidates/ (all trained policies -> competent -> selected); verify with --check.
provenance_note: Some checkpoints were assembled from other runs (selection.json records which pool checkpoint each cell uses); run.py --seed 42 regenerates a sweep from the same distribution, not these exact checkpoints. See evaluations/paper/cross_scenario/run.py.
history: Investigation-era results and the May 2026 evals of unselected cells live in archive/cross_scenario/ (local, not published); moves recorded in its MOVES*.json.
